name: Remembrance
source:
Remembrance is a visual novel that takes place at a college outside a fictional city in Washington. The protagonist (tbd) has chosen this college in order to get as far away from his past as he can. Having suffered a terrible past his home only carried painful memories for him. Upon arriving at the college he begins suffering headaches, and getting strange flashes of what seems to be forgotten memories. What's more he can't help but feel a weird sense of deja-vu about the city and college. The forest that surrounds and nearly consumes both the city and college almost seem to be calling to him.

As he meets other people things seem to only get weirder at the college. Nightmares and sudden flashes of unfamiliar memories get worse by the day. Just what is causing this? Play the game in order to figure out what is up with the strange forest and why people seem to be drawn to this place from all over! 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/915060127/remembrance-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
《追忆》是一部视觉小说，舞台设定在华盛顿州一座虚构城市郊外的大学。主人公（姓名待定）选择这所大学，是为了尽可能远离自己的过去。他曾经历可怕的往事，故乡只留下痛苦的回忆。抵达大学后，他开始头痛，并不断闪回似乎已经遗忘的记忆。更奇怪的是，面对这座城市和大学，他总有一种似曾相识的感觉。包围、几乎吞噬城市与大学的森林，仿佛也在呼唤他。

他与其他人相遇后，大学里的事情似乎变得更加诡异。噩梦和陌生记忆的突然闪回一天比一天严重。这究竟是什么造成的？游玩本作，找出神秘森林的真相，以及人们为何从各地被吸引到这里！

[来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/915060127/remembrance-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter项目页面[/url]]
